name: svg-french-press-perceptron-mk1.5-s3-r6
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 1000" width="600" height="1000">
  <style>
    .component { fill: none; stroke: #333; stroke-width: 2; }
    .glass { fill: rgba(200, 220, 255, 0.3); stroke: #4a90d9; stroke-width: 2; }
    .metal { fill: #e0e0e0; stroke: #666; stroke-width: 2; }
    .wood { fill: #8b5a2b; stroke: #5a3a1b; stroke-width: 2; }
    .mesh { fill: url(#meshPattern); stroke: #333; stroke-width: 1; }
    .label { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #333; }
    .leader-line { stroke: #999; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 8,4; }
  </style>
  
  <defs>
    <pattern id="meshPattern" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="8" height="8">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="8" y2="8" stroke="#333" stroke-width="0.5"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="8" x2="8" y2="0" stroke="#333" stroke-width="0.5"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="300" y="40" text-anchor="middle" class="label" font-size="24" font-weight="bold">French Press Exploded View</text>
  
  <!-- Component 1: Lid (top) -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 120)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="70" ry="15" class="metal"/>
    <rect x="-10" y="-25" width="20" height="25" class="wood" rx="3" ry="3"/>
    <text x="0" y="-35" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Lid with Handle</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 2: Glass Carafe -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 280)">
    <rect x="-60" y="-80" width="120" height="160" rx="5" ry="5" class="glass"/>
    <text x="0" y="-90" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Glass Carafe</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 3: Plunger Rod -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 500)">
    <rect x="-5" y="-100" width="10" height="200" class="metal" rx="2" ry="2"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="-100" r="15" class="wood"/>
    <text x="20" y="0" text-anchor="start" class="label">Plunger Rod</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 4: Filter Frame -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 680)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="65" ry="10" class="metal"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="55" ry="8" class="mesh"/>
    <text x="0" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Filter Frame</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Component 5: Base Plate -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 810)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="60" ry="8" class="metal"/>
    <text x="0" y="-15" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Base Plate</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Leader lines connecting components to labels -->
  <line x1="300" y1="135" x2="300" y2="160" class="leader-line"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="265" x2="300" y2="290" class="leader-line"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="485" x2="300" y2="510" class="leader-line"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="665" x2="300" y2="690" class="leader-line"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="795" x2="300" y2="820" class="leader-line"/>
  
  <!-- Assembly order indicator -->
  <text x="50" y="900" class="label" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Assembly Order:</text>
  <text x="50" y="920" class="label">1. Glass Carafe</text>
  <text x="50" y="940" class="label">2. Filter Frame + Base Plate</text>
  <text x="50" y="960" class="label">3. Plunger Rod</text>
  <text x="50" y="980" class="label">4. Lid</text>
</svg>
